purpose: Package the final mail bulk-organization qualification evidence, including failed attempts, without aggregating test counts.

excluded_names.advanced-heads-connector-comparisons.jso: Duplicate connector transport/comparison envelope; material findings and exact refs are retained in advanced-heads-audit.json, advanced-heads-review.md and intake audits.

counting_policy: The package index counts evidence files, helper sources, command records and ref records only. It does not sum passed, failed or skipped tests across attempts or suites.
determinism: Sorted archive paths; UTF-8 canonical JSON; tar uid/gid 0, names empty, mode 0644, mtime 0; gzip filename empty and mtime 0. Identical file bytes, context and git observations produce identical archive bytes.
safety: Only explicitly selected UTF-8 evidence is included. Symlinks, binaries, generated archives, lockfiles and credential-shaped content are rejected or excluded with a recorded reason. No evidence is deleted. No repository files or refs are modified.
